what_was_done: Delivered a unified Bob CEO panel that combines a TradingView-style chart workspace, AI assistant/wallet-style conversation card, and dense ops/firewall status cards.
Removed the visible legacy system drawer and stopped loading old panel scripts/styles.
Deleted unused legacy panel assets that only powered the removed drawer UI.
Changed Bob task submissions to use browser-local session IDs instead of the fixed sz-session.
Attached chart context only when the natural-language prompt actually asks about market/chart/stock/risk/portfolio topics.
Validated live endpoints, static assets, data routes, SSE streams, NDJSON task stream, and browser rendering.

risks.description: SSE checks end by timeout because the streams remain open by design.
risks.mitigation: Treat the received snapshot/heartbeat/log events as the pass signal, not curl exit code 28.

risks.description: Bob now answers broader natural-language finance questions, but output remains guidance and analysis, not execution.
